aboutText: Greenworks Garden Maintenance has been proudly serving Briar Hill and the surrounding north-eastern suburbs of Melbourne. With a comprehensive range of services including lawn mowing, garden cleanup, pruning, hedging, mulching, and irrigation, we ensure your garden thrives all year round. Our team is available from 8am to 7pm, Monday to Saturday, to provide reliable and affordable garden care. Contact us to keep your outdoor spaces looking their best.
servicesText: At Greenworks Garden Maintenance, we offer tailored garden care services to meet your specific needs. From routine lawn mowing to specialised irrigation systems, our expert team handles it all. Serving Briar Hill, we focus on quality and customer satisfaction to maintain beautiful gardens.
